# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities via the **Security** tab of the repository:

https://github.com/kim007-lol/music-players/security/advisories/new

If you cannot use the Security tab, open a private advisory or contact the maintainers via GitHub.

Do not disclose vulnerabilities publicly before a fix is available.

## Disclosure Policy

We follow a 90-day coordinated disclosure timeline. After a report is confirmed, we aim to ship a fix and publish an advisory within 90 days. Credit will be given to reporters unless anonymity is requested.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest release on the `main` branch.

## Scope

This policy covers the MusPlay app and its provider modules in this repository.
